Function: process_test_cases
Purpose: To determine if it is possible to place A rooks and B pawns on an N x N chessboard in a good arrangement for each test case.

Input:

     - If B > N * (N - 1), output "No" (since pawns cannot be placed directly below another piece except in the first row).
  5. If both conditions are satisfied, output "Yes".
  6. Otherwise, output "No".
